question.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

exchange.sent: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

answer.answer:
## Short answer
AI data center technology changes shift measurement needs toward broader non-signaling coverage of high-speed SI, PCB material/stackup, optical/CPO, power integrity, jitter/phase noise, and HVDC-related power behavior, while the cited signaling-tester evidence mainly supports wireless standards evolution such as Wi‑Fi 7/8, RedCap, LTE/5G NR, and OTA/signaling workflows rather than a direct AI data center link [3][5][12][15][22][30][83].
## What changed in AI data centers
AI / data center connectivity is described as a full-spectrum portfolio that combines high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection in one data center connectivity context [3].  
High-speed electrical connectivity includes claims such as XtremePass 448G across Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe, and InfiniBand systems, OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 with 200G/400G/800G/1.6T aggregate bandwidths, and Celerity mezzanine connectors up to 224 Gb/s PAM4 [61].  
Optical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for XPO-LPO, 200G/lane optical modules, co-packaged optics from high-density electrical interposer to optical conversion module to fiber plant, and 300G optical transceiver/cable examples [62].  
Power architecture is described as moving from a 48 V ecosystem toward 800 V or ±400Vdc as rack power reaches 200 kW to 250 kW, with examples of 800 V DC centralized generation and high-voltage DC distribution followed by local conversion on the server motherboard [5].  
AI server PCB technology is described as moving toward high layer count, large area, high-speed transmission, M8 CCL, low-Dk/low-loss/high-thermal designs, 30–40 layer motherboards, 12–14 aspect ratio, thick copper, and laser drilling challenges [68].  
## Effect on non-signaling tester measurement capability
Non-signaling PCB and SI test must cover Dk/Df, insertion loss, impedance variation, surface roughness, Delta-L loss, and TDR impedance measurement because the high-frequency/high-speed PCB test flow lists those items for material characterization, material selection, board sampling, and mass-production monitoring [12][74].  
R&S PCB test solutions similarly list Material Measurement with TDR impedance and DK/DF extraction, stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram, and SI modeling/testing plus sampling testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [15].  
For AI server PCBA and PCB mapping, the R&S solution table maps ZNL to PDN Target Z, MXO to power rail / multiphase DC / PI, ZISO, FSWP to LDO NSD and clock jitter test, ZNA to high-speed trace test, and ZNA/ZNB to IL and TDR [83].  
For connectors and cables, the same mapping places ZNA/ZNB plus OSP against high-speed cable testing, and separately states that ZNA/ZNB are used in PCB IL/TDR and connector/cable high-speed cable contexts [83][85].  
For optical / SiPh / CPO contexts, the mapping lists optical VNA using ZNA/ZNB plus PSA with ThinkLands, and ZNA/ZNB plus GOCA with Newkey, while also saying CPO raises active/passive SiPh, advanced packaging, and test demand [82].  
For jitter / phase-noise / clock-related capability, FSWP is mapped to LDO NSD test and clock jitter test in server motherboard, and to jitter / phase noise test in network switches [18].  
## Effect on signaling tester measurement capability
The cited signaling-tester evidence supports multi-technology and multi-channel capability: CMX500 is described as a multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester supporting LTE, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, NR FR2 millimeter-wave up to 50 GHz, latest 5G RedCap, and latest Wi‑Fi 7 in an EMITE OTA chamber integration context [22].  
For Wi‑Fi 8, CMX500 is described as implementing first Wi‑Fi 8 RF tests in signaling mode before final IEEE ratification and as a future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards [19].  
Wi‑Fi 8 testing adds dRU measurements for validating uplink transmit-power boosting and connection-reliability improvement, UEQM analysis for checking adaptation to specified MCS combinations, and broader signaling-mode tests for Wi‑Fi 8 feature/performance analysis [87].  
The Wi‑Fi 8 source also positions CMX500 as supporting LTE, NR SA/NSA, NR-NTN, NB-NTN, Direct-to-Cell / DTC, and WLAN including Wi‑Fi 7 and Wi‑Fi 8 [30].  
## Directly supported gap
The passages do not directly state that AI data center technology changes require CMX500 or any specific signaling tester configuration; the Wi‑Fi 7/8 and OTA passages are PR / solution-level statements and do not provide CMX500 option codes, hardware configuration, RF chain count, full test case lists, or measurement uncertainty [21][23][95][96].  
The AI server R&S solution mapping is only an Excel-derived sales / test-solution mapping and does not provide formal product configuration, option, fixture, frequency, calibration, or ordering information [83][86].  
## Inference
【推論】Because AI data center interconnect sources emphasize 224G/448G/1.6T electrical links and optical/CPO paths, while PCB/R&S sources list IL, TDR, DK/DF, roughness, Delta-L, high-speed trace, high-speed cable, optical VNA, jitter, and phase-noise measurements, the non-signaling tester capability likely needs to expand from basic continuity or low-speed checks toward broadband SI/channel/material/clock/power measurement coverage [61][62][12][15][82][83][85][18].  
【推論】Because AI data center power sources describe a shift from 48 V toward 800 V or ±400Vdc with local motherboard conversion, and the R&S mapping lists power rail, multiphase DC, PI, PDN Target Z, ZISO, LDO NSD, and BMS test, non-signaling power measurement capability likely needs stronger coverage of PDN, power integrity, noise, isolation, and DC power-conversion behavior [5][6][83][18].  
【推論】Because the signaling-tester passages focus on Wi‑Fi 7/8, RedCap, LTE/5G NR, OTA, dRU, UEQM, and multi-technology signaling, they support wireless-device signaling capability evolution, but they do not prove a direct AI data center measurement requirement without additional AI data center wireless-use evidence [19][22][30][87].

AI 資料中心高壓直流供電 › 800 V 到低壓供電路徑
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）研究兩種關鍵轉換路徑：`800 V → 54 V` 與 `800 V → 12 V`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，三級架構先將 `800 V` 降至 `54 V`，再經由 [[IBC]] 與 [[VRM]] 功率級或背面 [[垂直供電]] 模組進一步降壓，可降低 [[PDN]] 損耗，並支援 IBC 與 VRM 級均位於夾層卡上的方案。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，二級架構 `800 V → 12 V` 可省去一個完整功率轉換級，節省主板空間。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，Infineon 開發 `800 V → 12 V` 的 `6 kW` 示範板，功率密度超過 `2300 W/in³`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，`800 V → 12 V` 示範板採用對稱布局，由兩組堆疊式 LLC 變換器組成，並採用矩陣變壓器結構。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，`800 V → 12 V` 示範板初級側採用 `650 V` [[CoolGaN]] 技術，次級側使用 `40 V` 矽基 [[OptiMOS]] 6 系列。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，[[PSOC]] MCU 與 [[EiceDriver]] gate driver 提供 PWM 與驅動信號。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，`800 V → 12 V` 轉換器測試結果為峰值效率 `97.4%`、滿載效率 `96.6%`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）另探索 `800 V → 50 V → 6 V`，其中 `800 V → 50 V` 堆疊式 LLC 變換級在諧振頻率下工作，峰值效率達 `98.5%`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，[[Hybrid Switched Capacitor]] 拓撲結合磁能與電容能量傳遞，用於中壓 [[IBC]] 將電壓進一步降至 `6 V`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，Infineon 正在開發額定功率 `1 kW`、固定 `8:1` 轉換比的電源模組，用於將現有 `48 V/50 V` 電壓域轉換至 `6 V` 中間匯流排。
- [[SST(Solid State Transformer ) image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）只標示 Data Center 側 **800 VDC**；來源未提供 `800 V → 54 V`、`800 V → 12 V`、`800 V → 50 V → 6 V` 或晶片端低壓轉換路徑。

AI 資料中心高壓直流供電 › 來源中的說法
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，隨著 GPU 功耗上升與每機架 GPU 叢集規模擴大，單機架功率需求將很快突破 `1 MW` 或更高。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，當單機架功率達 MW 等級，系統架構必須從既有 `48 V` 生態系轉向高壓直流供電。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）預計，從 `48 V` 匯流排架構轉向 `800 V` 或 [[±400Vdc]] 架構，會在單機架功率達 `200 kW` 至 `250 kW` 時出現。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，在 `48 V` 匯流排架構下，單機架功率 `200 kW` 至 `250 kW` 對應母排電流約 `4100 A` 至 `5200 A`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）提出高壓直流架構示例：採用 `800 V DC` 的集中發電與高壓直流配電，並在伺服器主板進行本地功率轉換。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，未來伺服器主板將直接運行於 `800 V` 或 [[±400Vdc]] 電壓。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，高壓直流伺服器主板需要在插入高壓直流匯流排前執行預充電，並在伺服器主板從 IT 機架移除時確保開關及時放電，以避免危險電壓。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）指出，每個伺服器主板需部署 [[eFuse]] 功能，以便故障時快速切斷電源。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）展示基於 [[XDP]] 熱插拔控制器 `XDP70x` 與 [[CoolSiC]] [[JFET]] 的 [[eFuse]] 與 hot-swap 控制方案；實驗條件為輸入電容 `300 µF`，可將伺服器主板從 `0 V` 預充電至 `800 V`。
- [[SST(Solid State Transformer ) image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖中 [[Data Center]] 應用旁標示 **800 VDC**，其 AC-DC 方塊標示為 **AC-DC (SST)**。
- [[SST(Solid State Transformer ) image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖上方標示 **34.5 kVAc or 13.8 kVAc 3-Ph Grid**，表示該概念圖把 [[SST]] 放在中高壓三相電網與 DC 應用介面之間。
- [[SST(Solid State Transformer ) image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖說稱：**SST technology fueled by AI data centers set to modernize grid-infrastructure across battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV megawatt charging systems (MCS), and renewable energy**；這只能作為未標示日期圖上的敘事，不能視為已導入或市場共識。

- 展示地點為 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 可 showcase physical layer features unique to [[Wi-Fi 8]]。
- 來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，以及 future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards。

- [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / [[Broadcom]] PR 支撐，聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode、[[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY features 與 prototype Broadcom WLAN device。

- non-cellular technologies：latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- integration enables support of LTE、FR1、FR2、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- EMITE customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] and [[5G RedCap]] devices。

- 來源未標示發布日期。
- 來源未標示 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的硬體 BOM、software option code、CSW version、RF chain count 或 license requirement。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCB material 與 insertion loss

- Data rate 越高，loss 越高。
- [[Insertion loss]] 與 board material 有關。
- Ultra Low Loss material 在不同 data rate 下的 loss 低於 standard loss material。
- Megtron 6 等 ultra low-loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 預期比 nominal temperature 高最多 8%。

- [[3GPP Release 17]] defined 5G technology。
- reduced-functionality version of 5G。
- significantly lower cost compared to [[5G eMBB]]。
- mid-range data throughput。
- low power consumption。
- low complexity。
- ability to support a large number of devices。
- particularly attractive for [[IoT]] applications。

- low latency。

- immersive virtual reality。

answer.text:
## Short answer
AI data center technology changes shift measurement needs toward broader non-signaling coverage of high-speed SI, PCB material/stackup, optical/CPO, power integrity, jitter/phase noise, and HVDC-related power behavior, while the cited signaling-tester evidence mainly supports wireless standards evolution such as Wi‑Fi 7/8, RedCap, LTE/5G NR, and OTA/signaling workflows rather than a direct AI data center link [3][5][12][15][22][30][83].
## What changed in AI data centers
AI / data center connectivity is described as a full-spectrum portfolio that combines high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection in one data center connectivity context [3].  
High-speed electrical connectivity includes claims such as XtremePass 448G across Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe, and InfiniBand systems, OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 with 200G/400G/800G/1.6T aggregate bandwidths, and Celerity mezzanine connectors up to 224 Gb/s PAM4 [61].  
Optical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for XPO-LPO, 200G/lane optical modules, co-packaged optics from high-density electrical interposer to optical conversion module to fiber plant, and 300G optical transceiver/cable examples [62].  
Power architecture is described as moving from a 48 V ecosystem toward 800 V or ±400Vdc as rack power reaches 200 kW to 250 kW, with examples of 800 V DC centralized generation and high-voltage DC distribution followed by local conversion on the server motherboard [5].  
AI server PCB technology is described as moving toward high layer count, large area, high-speed transmission, M8 CCL, low-Dk/low-loss/high-thermal designs, 30–40 layer motherboards, 12–14 aspect ratio, thick copper, and laser drilling challenges [68].  
## Effect on non-signaling tester measurement capability
Non-signaling PCB and SI test must cover Dk/Df, insertion loss, impedance variation, surface roughness, Delta-L loss, and TDR impedance measurement because the high-frequency/high-speed PCB test flow lists those items for material characterization, material selection, board sampling, and mass-production monitoring [12][74].  
R&S PCB test solutions similarly list Material Measurement with TDR impedance and DK/DF extraction, stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram, and SI modeling/testing plus sampling testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [15].  
For AI server PCBA and PCB mapping, the R&S solution table maps ZNL to PDN Target Z, MXO to power rail / multiphase DC / PI, ZISO, FSWP to LDO NSD and clock jitter test, ZNA to high-speed trace test, and ZNA/ZNB to IL and TDR [83].  
For connectors and cables, the same mapping places ZNA/ZNB plus OSP against high-speed cable testing, and separately states that ZNA/ZNB are used in PCB IL/TDR and connector/cable high-speed cable contexts [83][85].  
For optical / SiPh / CPO contexts, the mapping lists optical VNA using ZNA/ZNB plus PSA with ThinkLands, and ZNA/ZNB plus GOCA with Newkey, while also saying CPO raises active/passive SiPh, advanced packaging, and test demand [82].  
For jitter / phase-noise / clock-related capability, FSWP is mapped to LDO NSD test and clock jitter test in server motherboard, and to jitter / phase noise test in network switches [18].  
## Effect on signaling tester measurement capability
The cited signaling-tester evidence supports multi-technology and multi-channel capability: CMX500 is described as a multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester supporting LTE, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, NR FR2 millimeter-wave up to 50 GHz, latest 5G RedCap, and latest Wi‑Fi 7 in an EMITE OTA chamber integration context [22].  
For Wi‑Fi 8, CMX500 is described as implementing first Wi‑Fi 8 RF tests in signaling mode before final IEEE ratification and as a future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards [19].  
Wi‑Fi 8 testing adds dRU measurements for validating uplink transmit-power boosting and connection-reliability improvement, UEQM analysis for checking adaptation to specified MCS combinations, and broader signaling-mode tests for Wi‑Fi 8 feature/performance analysis [87].  
The Wi‑Fi 8 source also positions CMX500 as supporting LTE, NR SA/NSA, NR-NTN, NB-NTN, Direct-to-Cell / DTC, and WLAN including Wi‑Fi 7 and Wi‑Fi 8 [30].  
## Directly supported gap
The passages do not directly state that AI data center technology changes require CMX500 or any specific signaling tester configuration; the Wi‑Fi 7/8 and OTA passages are PR / solution-level statements and do not provide CMX500 option codes, hardware configuration, RF chain count, full test case lists, or measurement uncertainty [21][23][95][96].  
The AI server R&S solution mapping is only an Excel-derived sales / test-solution mapping and does not provide formal product configuration, option, fixture, frequency, calibration, or ordering information [83][86].  
## Inference
【推論】Because AI data center interconnect sources emphasize 224G/448G/1.6T electrical links and optical/CPO paths, while PCB/R&S sources list IL, TDR, DK/DF, roughness, Delta-L, high-speed trace, high-speed cable, optical VNA, jitter, and phase-noise measurements, the non-signaling tester capability likely needs to expand from basic continuity or low-speed checks toward broadband SI/channel/material/clock/power measurement coverage [61][62][12][15][82][83][85][18].  
【推論】Because AI data center power sources describe a shift from 48 V toward 800 V or ±400Vdc with local motherboard conversion, and the R&S mapping lists power rail, multiphase DC, PI, PDN Target Z, ZISO, LDO NSD, and BMS test, non-signaling power measurement capability likely needs stronger coverage of PDN, power integrity, noise, isolation, and DC power-conversion behavior [5][6][83][18].  
【推論】Because the signaling-tester passages focus on Wi‑Fi 7/8, RedCap, LTE/5G NR, OTA, dRU, UEQM, and multi-technology signaling, they support wireless-device signaling capability evolution, but they do not prove a direct AI data center measurement requirement without additional AI data center wireless-use evidence [19][22][30][87].

- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）研究兩種關鍵轉換路徑：`800 V → 54 V` 與 `800 V → 12 V`。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，三級架構先將 `800 V` 降至 `54 V`，再經由 [[IBC]] 與 [[VRM]] 功率級或背面 [[垂直供電]] 模組進一步降壓，可降低 [[PDN]] 損耗，並支援 IBC 與 VRM 級均位於夾層卡上的方案。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，二級架構 `800 V → 12 V` 可省去一個完整功率轉換級，節省主板空間。

answer.text:
## Short answer
AI data center technology changes shift measurement needs toward broader non-signaling coverage of high-speed SI, PCB material/stackup, optical/CPO, power integrity, jitter/phase noise, and HVDC-related power behavior, while the cited signaling-tester evidence mainly supports wireless standards evolution such as Wi‑Fi 7/8, RedCap, LTE/5G NR, and OTA/signaling workflows rather than a direct AI data center link [3][5][12][15][22][30][83].
## What changed in AI data centers
AI / data center connectivity is described as a full-spectrum portfolio that combines high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection in one data center connectivity context [3].  
High-speed electrical connectivity includes claims such as XtremePass 448G across Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe, and InfiniBand systems, OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 with 200G/400G/800G/1.6T aggregate bandwidths, and Celerity mezzanine connectors up to 224 Gb/s PAM4 [61].  
Optical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for XPO-LPO, 200G/lane optical modules, co-packaged optics from high-density electrical interposer to optical conversion module to fiber plant, and 300G optical transceiver/cable examples [62].  
Power architecture is described as moving from a 48 V ecosystem toward 800 V or ±400Vdc as rack power reaches 200 kW to 250 kW, with examples of 800 V DC centralized generation and high-voltage DC distribution followed by local conversion on the server motherboard [5].  
AI server PCB technology is described as moving toward high layer count, large area, high-speed transmission, M8 CCL, low-Dk/low-loss/high-thermal designs, 30–40 layer motherboards, 12–14 aspect ratio, thick copper, and laser drilling challenges [68].  
## Effect on non-signaling tester measurement capability
Non-signaling PCB and SI test must cover Dk/Df, insertion loss, impedance variation, surface roughness, Delta-L loss, and TDR impedance measurement because the high-frequency/high-speed PCB test flow lists those items for material characterization, material selection, board sampling, and mass-production monitoring [12][74].  
R&S PCB test solutions similarly list Material Measurement with TDR impedance and DK/DF extraction, stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram, and SI modeling/testing plus sampling testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [15].  
For AI server PCBA and PCB mapping, the R&S solution table maps ZNL to PDN Target Z, MXO to power rail / multiphase DC / PI, ZISO, FSWP to LDO NSD and clock jitter test, ZNA to high-speed trace test, and ZNA/ZNB to IL and TDR [83].  
For connectors and cables, the same mapping places ZNA/ZNB plus OSP against high-speed cable testing, and separately states that ZNA/ZNB are used in PCB IL/TDR and connector/cable high-speed cable contexts [83][85].  
For optical / SiPh / CPO contexts, the mapping lists optical VNA using ZNA/ZNB plus PSA with ThinkLands, and ZNA/ZNB plus GOCA with Newkey, while also saying CPO raises active/passive SiPh, advanced packaging, and test demand [82].  
For jitter / phase-noise / clock-related capability, FSWP is mapped to LDO NSD test and clock jitter test in server motherboard, and to jitter / phase noise test in network switches [18].  
## Effect on signaling tester measurement capability
The cited signaling-tester evidence supports multi-technology and multi-channel capability: CMX500 is described as a multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester supporting LTE, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, NR FR2 millimeter-wave up to 50 GHz, latest 5G RedCap, and latest Wi‑Fi 7 in an EMITE OTA chamber integration context [22].  
For Wi‑Fi 8, CMX500 is described as implementing first Wi‑Fi 8 RF tests in signaling mode before final IEEE ratification and as a future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards [19].  
Wi‑Fi 8 testing adds dRU measurements for validating uplink transmit-power boosting and connection-reliability improvement, UEQM analysis for checking adaptation to specified MCS combinations, and broader signaling-mode tests for Wi‑Fi 8 feature/performance analysis [87].  
The Wi‑Fi 8 source also positions CMX500 as supporting LTE, NR SA/NSA, NR-NTN, NB-NTN, Direct-to-Cell / DTC, and WLAN including Wi‑Fi 7 and Wi‑Fi 8 [30].  
## Directly supported gap
The passages do not directly state that AI data center technology changes require CMX500 or any specific signaling tester configuration; the Wi‑Fi 7/8 and OTA passages are PR / solution-level statements and do not provide CMX500 option codes, hardware configuration, RF chain count, full test case lists, or measurement uncertainty [21][23][95][96].  
The AI server R&S solution mapping is only an Excel-derived sales / test-solution mapping and does not provide formal product configuration, option, fixture, frequency, calibration, or ordering information [83][86].  
## Inference
【推論】Because AI data center interconnect sources emphasize 224G/448G/1.6T electrical links and optical/CPO paths, while PCB/R&S sources list IL, TDR, DK/DF, roughness, Delta-L, high-speed trace, high-speed cable, optical VNA, jitter, and phase-noise measurements, the non-signaling tester capability likely needs to expand from basic continuity or low-speed checks toward broadband SI/channel/material/clock/power measurement coverage [61][62][12][15][82][83][85][18].  
【推論】Because AI data center power sources describe a shift from 48 V toward 800 V or ±400Vdc with local motherboard conversion, and the R&S mapping lists power rail, multiphase DC, PI, PDN Target Z, ZISO, LDO NSD, and BMS test, non-signaling power measurement capability likely needs stronger coverage of PDN, power integrity, noise, isolation, and DC power-conversion behavior [5][6][83][18].  
【推論】Because the signaling-tester passages focus on Wi‑Fi 7/8, RedCap, LTE/5G NR, OTA, dRU, UEQM, and multi-technology signaling, they support wireless-device signaling capability evolution, but they do not prove a direct AI data center measurement requirement without additional AI data center wireless-use evidence [19][22][30][87].
